description: SevvaAI is a solo project for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, addressing the “Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map” challenge. The name comes from “Sevvai” (செவ்வாய்), the Tamil name for Mars, combined with AI (Artificial Intelligence). SevvaAI aims to make Martian exploration more accessible through AI-assisted maps, mission data, scientific information, and intelligent exploration planning.
